- Model uses `BranchScoped` global scope (direct branch_id)
- DO NOT add new composer dependencies

## Implementation steps
1. Create migration `2026_06_01_120000_create_widgets_table.php`:

   - `name` string(120)
   - `branch_id` UUID FK branches
